capabilities: Organize papers and webpages into collections, subcategories and writing projects
Generate AI-suggested titles, TL;DR summaries, tags and categories for papers
Track reviews and submissions with venue deadlines and countdowns
Export citations in BibTeX, APA or IEEE formats
Browse and edit tags in a two-sided mind map with filters and bookmarks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README references separate AI, data-and-privacy, workspace-agents and performance guides not included here. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+.
intentEvidence: A compact, Zotero-style literature manager for Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage a research paper library with collections, citation metadata, reference export and manuscript submission deadlines.

relations.evidence: A compact, Zotero-style literature manager for Obsidian
DeepSeek Beta is included and enabled by default. Add your API key

summary: Zotero-style literature manager that organizes papers, PDFs and webpages into collections, with AI-assisted tagging, citation export and deadline tracking.
